concept: Optical Courier: a 7.25-head stylized humanoid with a rounded graphite visor and one vertical teal signal, cropped off-white shell jacket, restrained graphite panels, tapered charcoal trousers, fitted black gloves, and amber-accented soles.
positivePrompt: Character turnaround reference sheet of one original Optical Courier, the exact same character shown three times side by side: front view on the left, true left profile in the middle, back view on the right. Full body head to soles, neutral T-pose, arms straight out horizontally, palms down, feet shoulder width, centered in each panel, approximately 7.25 heads tall. Rounded graphite visor covering the face with exactly one narrow vertical teal signal centered on the visor. Cropped off-white shell jacket ending above the hips with restrained flat graphite shoulder and side panels, tapered charcoal trousers, fitted black gloves, compact black boots with a thin amber sole accent. Clean connected simple humanoid silhouette, low-poly production character, practical seam placement around shoulders hips knees and elbows, symmetrical proportions, uniform light gray studio background, soft even shadowless lighting, orthographic character design sheet, no text, no labels.
negativePrompt: hard hat, helmet brim, backpack, camera, camera prop, cable, cape, tail, armor, weapon, tool, pouch, holster, antenna, goggles, exposed face, asymmetrical clothing, extra limbs, bent arms, perspective view, action pose, shadows, text, labels, floor props, environment

failedAttempts.cause: Three full image-plus-geometry workflows were incorrectly queued together; memory-map release left the model with no usable VRAM and the server unresponsive.
failedAttempts.remediation: Restarted the exact verified Comfy Desktop server process, cleared VRAM, and ran image candidates sequentially before changing model families. No output from this failed attempt was promoted.

review.viewConsistency: Front, true-left, and back panels retain the same visor, jacket, trousers, gloves, boots, and proportions.
review.notes: Selected: strongest identity consistency, covered graphite visor with one vertical teal signal, clean slim T-pose, cropped off-white jacket, charcoal trousers, black gloves and boots, amber sole accent.

review.viewConsistency: Front, left, and back are broadly consistent, but the head silhouette violates the brief.

rejectionHistory.reason: Reviewer rejected ragged voxel/material seams at the neck, shoulders, gloves, and ankles; crude hands and boots; a weak jacket silhouette; and insufficient fidelity to the selected concept. This historical FBX must not be uploaded to Mixamo.

hunyuanProof.measuredReason: Blender 5.2 found 62,000 vertices, 126,044 triangles, one connected component, and 2,826 non-manifold edges. The raw voxel extraction was rejected for deformation. A later repaired derivative is tracked separately as upload-review-ready and is the only asset approved for one constrained Mixamo upload/rig test; the original proof is never an upload source.

visualFidelityCandidate.notes: Seeded QuadriFlow was attempted and returned CANCELLED on the closed voxel-union source. The truthful fallback uses deterministic manifold voxel union plus controlled collapse to 24,000 triangles, continuous position-masked materials, a surface-mounted teal signal, and bakeable zipper/pocket masks. Round-two review corrected the helmet-like head: warm skin now covers the scalp, crown, sides, and back, while graphite is confined to the front visor band. Independent pre-rig review approved exactly mixamoUploadAsset for one constrained Mixamo upload/rig test. Joint-section counts are occupancy bins, not verified deformation edge loops. productionApproved remains false, and no Mixamo rigging or production GLB is claimed.

mixamo.reason: The required Google Chrome control extension/native host is unavailable. No alternative browser or UI automation was used.
mixamo.nextAction: When required Google Chrome control is restored, verify the Adobe session and upload only the explicitly approved visualFidelityCandidate.mixamoUploadAsset for one constrained rig test. Never upload the rejected historical FBX.
